title: Create: Zinc Recipe
description: Adds a recipe for zinc in the create mod.
body:
Running low on Zinc in your Create world? Sick of scavenging caves and strip mines just to power up your machines? With this easy to use mod, make Raw Zinc craftable so that you don’t have to disrupt your automation project with a new round of mining.

All you need is:

Lapis Lazuli
Iron Nugget

Craft these into Raw Zinc and smelt it down into Zinc so that you won't have to depend completely on your world generation anymore. Whether you are constructing mega factories, processing plants or fully automated production chains, this mod will allow you to produce Zinc in an automated manner.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6005167d7dfa3585af53559d43bce2fbd165592.png)!

Features:

Allows you to craft Raw Zinc
Provides renewable sources of Zinc
Can be used with full automation through Create contraptions
Naturally fits into Create's progression and gameplay mechanics
Lightweight

Requires: [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
